notes.title: Update - Garden Trills - 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thank you once again for all your support and for the lovely reviews you wrote for the game! I hope this update can improve your experience with various QoL features.

If you encounter any issues while playing the game, don't hesitate to reach out to me at "gardentrills@gmail.com" to report it!

[b]New Features: Improved Map[/b]
- Map zooming!
- You can now teleport to a street directly from the HUB's map by clicking on the passionflower icon.
- Blooming score is explained on the map.
- Waypoints are clearer.
- Birdhouses that stay open indefinitely are indicated with a specific icon on the map (you can farm seeds using these).

[b]Other New Features[/b]
- Quests will ping you when their conditions have been fulfilled and their descriptions will update (indicating that you need to talk to a specific bird to complete it and get your reward).
- Hide UI key, if you want to take a screenshot without the HUD getting in the way!
- Propeller hat now spins as you move around.

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Improved popup menu button clarity.
- Improved vertical range for watering cans.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Fixing floating objects.
- Various bugfixes.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you so much for all the support for the game's release! I hope you're having a great time flying around the game's gardens. I've noticed and have been informed of a few bugs, so here's a patch with some fixes. Don't hesitate to reach out to me at "gardentrills@gmail.com" to report a bug, it helps me a lot.


- "Red backpack" missing texture fixed. 
Players who continued a save started in the demo might have unlocked the "red backpack" which was then removed (it became the orange backpack), resulting in a missing backpack. I added a new "red backpack" color variant to fix it. It's waiting for you in Lionheart Square.
- Completion percentage in Snowdrop correctly starts at 0% now (and not 8%)
Dead plant burried fix in B2
- Waypoint for Ivory Esplanade won't be unlocked automatically and will wait for you to unlock the area.
- Marble radar quest will not restart once completed.
- Fixed a bug that locked you in the pause menu if you clicked on a different category while saving.
- Fixed a bug with the controller where cursor would disappear on the map after cancelling a fast-travel.
- Credits popup fully displayed when using a controller in the Home Menu.
- Typos fixed

notes.title: Hotfix - Garden Trills Demo - 0.10.4
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for trying out the demo. I received a lot of useful feedback and worked on some of the bugs reported.

Features:
- Waypoint teleporters added to the map. I'm working hard on removing all nook an crannies where Tomi can get stuck but in case that happens, I'm adding the possibility to teleport to these waypoints which should help you get out of tricky situations.
- Dad can retrieve lost gifts when you talk to him.
- Added an option to manually switch between a QWERTY/QWERTZ and an AZERTY keyboard.

Improvements:
- Flower description tags are bigger.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a bug where some accessories colors couldn't be navigated to using a controller.
- Fixed a bug where "First contact" quest completion wouldn't trigger an announcement.
- Improved plant collisions to avoid getting stuck as they grow.

notes.title: Small Update - Garden Trills Demo - 0.10.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you once again for all the support and feedback. I wasn't planning on updating the demo this early but I found a pretty major bug that affected players with german keyboards and wanted to fix it ASAP. Since I'm doing an update, I've added new exploration secrets.

Feature:
- New cosmetics
- Bramble hurts

Upgrades:
- More variety in birdhouse dialogues
- Clearer indicator for closed birdhouses
- Improved camera
- Prettier environments
- Higher FOV (will help reduce motion sickness). By the way, you can modify FOV in the menu.


Bugfixes:
- QWERTZ keyboards are properly detected (sorry german players)
- Fixed a bug where menu couldn't be opened anymore if closed while a popup is open
- Chantal will stay in Lionheart Square even after reopening a save
- Fixed a bug that rollbacked worlds after changing worlds if autosaving was off

notes.title: Small Update - Garden Trills Demo - 0.10.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

A huge thank you for all the support and nice messages I received! I've also been reading a lot of your feedback and this update is a first step in answering your requests and improving the game. The new quest log and improvements to the flying controls should make the experience a lot smoother and help players who might get stuck.


[b]New features[/b]
- Added a quest log, to keep track of your active and completed quests.
- "Disable camera shake/waver" option
- Windowed display and resolution options


[b]Improvements[/b]
- Easier and more intuitive flying controls
- Improved watering can movement (it shouldn't get stuck anymore).
- Camera based control of the planting location (instead of using Tomi's orientation, which can be hard to control)
- Pretty flowers and other cool upgrades and additions.


[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Camera rotation when using the mouse should be smoother. Fixed a bug that ignore fine mouse movements.
- Typo fixes in dialogues.
- Holding the key for too long when opening a menu will not close it immediately.
- Minor bug fixes
